authority: Operational proposal for existing revision 3 usefulness/coverage/abstention rule. Root review required before freezing; does not alter proposal, cases, critical gates, permissions or user decisions.

exposure.raw_basis: Only declared case bodies, independent truth criteria, recipes and raw-oracle operands from revision 3.

usefulness_scale.0: Misses the requested issue or substitutes unsupported/irrelevant content.
usefulness_scale.1: Restates the available baseline evidence without useful added interpretation.
usefulness_scale.2: Adds a correct, case-specific explanation of meaning, prerequisites or limits tied to evidence.

global_scoring.facet_evaluation: Assess meaning, not exact wording. A concise answer can satisfy several facets. Do not reward length or require disclosure of hidden implementation details. Score only requested answer facets; inspect read/save/budget/security requirements separately as operational evidence.
global_scoring.coverage: For every arm and case record the fixed facets satisfied correctly and the fixed facets omitted. Incorrect/unsupported statements never count as coverage. Retain all 32 cases in outcome reporting. Not-assessable cases are not successes and must remain separately counted.
global_scoring.abstention: Correctly refusing only an unsupported facet counts as correct coverage of its limit. Blanket refusal loses supported facets. A required positive that is absent from the actual path is a functional failure, not a passing safe refusal; if its raw prerequisite was never bound, record not_assessable instead of silently changing expected output.
global_scoring.regression_proposal: Compare each fixed facet against baseline on identical inputs. A candidate regression is a baseline-correct requested facet becoming omitted/incorrect, an added unsupported claim, failure of a required refusal, or unnecessary refusal of a supported positive facet. List every regression explicitly; do not offset one with extra prose or a different facet. Proposed interpretation of the existing no-loss clause: a candidate with any unresolved coverage/abstention regression does not satisfy the proposed comparison rule, even when summed usefulness improves. Root accepted this operational interpretation; the overall addendum remains proposed until raw bindings, transport and seal are complete. It is not a new universal release gate.
global_scoring.candidate_rule: Retain original rule: zero critical violations, more case-level usefulness improvements than regressions, higher summed usefulness than baseline, and no coverage/abstention loss under the reviewed binding. Critical results cannot be offset by usefulness. Apply independently to each candidate; retain three-arm outcomes and separate evidence strata.
global_scoring.not_assessable_usefulness: For numeric comparison accounting assign zero earned usefulness to unexecuted/failed/not-assessable outcomes and retain their explicit status; do not call these answers usefulness-zero responses or successful tests. Report their counts next to any total. An incomplete required comparison cannot become complete through favorable totals.
global_scoring.blindness: Freeze masked arm identities and random seed before answers. First assess each displayed answer against fixed raw truth, facets and the 0/1/2 explanation-quality scale without trying to identify baseline or candidate. Freeze all per-arm facet, grounding, abstention and usefulness grades. Only then unmask and compute paired baseline-relative improvements, regressions and totals. Evidence restatement means restatement of available evidence, not identification of a baseline-labelled output during blind grading.
global_scoring.boundaries: All original critical, browser, save/reopen/recovery, actual cost/request/latency reporting and user-choice gates remain separate. No market edge, probability calibration, fresh-real coverage or paper readiness can be inferred.
global_scoring.answer_surface: Grade displayed summary, sections and other visible useful answer content. Raw internal fact presence alone cannot earn a requested explanation. Evidence records verify grounding and operational truth; they do not automatically earn usefulness or answer-facet coverage. For the two pre-admission display-refusal cases, grade the actual visible validation/refusal message; no research summary or sections are required. Zero-admission/read/model proof remains a separate operational check.

numeric_policy.identity_and_scope: Ticker, units, sign, source class, chosen expiry/selection, missing-vs-zero, clock identity and relationship direction must match exactly in meaning. Numeric tolerance cannot excuse an identity/scope error.
numeric_policy.raw_oracle: Independent arithmetic from frozen raw inputs only; do not use the production answer/fact builder as its own truth. Freeze every derived expected value and operand reference before any answer.
numeric_policy.two_decimal_outputs: For values whose existing output contract rounds to two decimals, compare decimal rounding to the frozen two-decimal expected value. Do not accept an adjacent cent merely by using a broad epsilon. More precise prose is valid if consistent with the unrounded independent value and stated display precision.
numeric_policy.nonrounded_numeric: For full-precision computed floating-point values, proposed tolerance is max(1e-9 absolute, 1e-9 times absolute expected). Freeze any existing contract-specific presentation rounding before answers. This tolerance never changes eligibility, missing values, signs or scope.
numeric_policy.source_numbers: For directly quoted raw source numbers compare their numeric value at supplied source precision; format differences are allowed. Do not round measured zero into a nonzero or vice versa.
numeric_policy.times_and_counts: Discrete counts, stored timestamps, expiry dates and selected strikes are exact. Human-readable equivalent timezone/units are accepted when they preserve the same value and meaning.
numeric_policy.not_every_oracle_value_is_an_answer_face: The numeric bindings below support verification. Answers are not required to recite every raw operand, intermediate result or optional bound if the requested facets are correctly covered.
numeric_policy.unbound_values: Recorded-source prices, display units/cells, pinned-calendar dates and other currently unbound values remain pending independent raw extraction. No values may be guessed, borrowed from old answers or chosen after new answers.
